title: About us
metaTitle: About Mas Oyama Karate New Zealand
metaDescription: Kyokushin karate in New Zealand since 1965, with a direct lineage through Sosai Mas Oyama.

blocks.text: Hanshi Doug Holloway, 8th dan, set up the first Kyokushin karate dojo in New Zealand in 1965, after returning from Japan as a student of Sosai Mas Oyama.
Kyokushin means the ultimate truth. It is taught here by people who learned it from the source.
